item.description: Ken Schreiber has made a generous donation of $400,000 with the aim of preserving Neil Armstrong's childhood home, highlighting its important place in history. The Auglaize County Historical Society plans to restore the house to its original 1940s charm, inspired by Schreiber's deep admiration for Armstrong. item.title: Out of control? France stunned by October 17 rioting
item.description: France didn't just erupt on Saturday – it exploded. Police were doubly overwhelmed by the turnout of the October 17 cost-of-living demonstrations, which saw two and-a-half times the crowds they expected. Officers were also overwhelmed by determined flashmobs: some radical militants hellbent on a fight, others who came for the looting. The whole world watched the assault on symbols of the Republic like the 19th-century city hall in Limoges, the usually quiet porcelain capital of France. Fuente: France 24 - English.
